note: Q9 part 1: All product consensus-character computations were traced to _getConsensusOptions except three places that bypass it. Defects: (1) block-mask.js line 21 CODE omits U, so parseAln (line 104) turns every uracil of an RNA alignment into a gap before the mask is built — high; (2) block-mask.js buildMajorityConsensusRow (133) does its own majority vote with no opts, inheriting the U-as-gap corruption; (3) script.js _consensusTooltipHtml normalizes U→T (14600) and labels frequency rows with the 'T' colorMap key (14607), so the column tooltip still shows T for RNA even though the consensus letter itself is now U. Verified clean: the main render consensus (script.js 12800 via computeConsensusForSequences → _getConsensusOptions), copySelectedConsensus/replace/add-below/copy paths (17693, 30223, 30462 all build opts from _getConsensusOptions), consensusDisplayBase/_canvasConsensusUpper (case-only, handle U directly), and no consensus computing in cluster.js, block-bicluster.js, peel.js or finder.js. macse-align.js has its own consensusSequence code that I could not finish tracing before the budget cutoff — logged in the uncertain list, no verdict claimed.
